note: Opened the linked 1987 guide text: its core summary and body identify Ding-mao (丁卯) as the Fire Rabbit year, including the span through February 16, 1988. This supports the statement that the early-1988 births fall in the year covered by the linked page.
sentence: Everyone born January 1 through February 16, 1988, the 47 days before that boundary, was born under the outgoing year instead, Ding-mao (丁卯), Fire Rabbit, the same Fire Rabbit year described in [the 1987 guide](/1987-chinese-zodiac/).
